pairs.evidence: src/lib/llm/transport/claude.ts:109 probe() runs `claude auth status` in the unstripped host environment, while run() deletes ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (line 147), so on a host that carries a key the probe describes a metered-key process nobody launches. It also folds an unparseable auth-status result into authed:false instead of unknown.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/llm/transport/claude.ts:109 The probe env differs from the run env, which is the named failure. Its result is two-valued: line 122 returns authed:false on any auth-status error, with no unknown state.
